rooms.name: Hinge Door
rooms.description: The door is hung on the same pin as a floodgate. It shivers as the lake presses against the far side.

rooms.name: Gauge Balcony
rooms.description: Two arrows give the heights of the ferry lake and the borough roof. Their tips point at one another.

rooms.name: Rock Anchor
rooms.description: A brass nut the size of a stool holds the master hinge into the mountain.

rooms.name: Drum Gallery
rooms.description: The relief drums growl in sequence. The last drum makes a short sound like a cough.

rooms.name: Seat Crack
rooms.description: A fine stream crosses the inspection lamp. The crack widens on every return stroke, just as Edda said.

rooms.name: Keeper's Oath
rooms.description: Someone scratched out the words about city property and wrote all who draw breath below.

rooms.name: Winch Circle
rooms.description: A circular walk powers the emergency winch. Shoe marks show that adults and children once walked here together.

rooms.name: Spare Shoe
rooms.description: A huge oak gate shoe stands upright like a gravestone. The carpenter marked the living grain in chalk.

rooms.name: Overflow Eye
rooms.description: A round opening looks out onto empty cliffs. Water sent this way would pass the homes but empty the lake.

rooms.name: Seal Buttress
rooms.description: The buttress can isolate the lower homes while holding the ferry lake at its old mark. A bell warns that the homes must be cleared first.

rooms.name: Balancing Fork
rooms.description: Two equal branches divide the spill. One branch leads back to the spring conduit through a ceramic sleeve.

rooms.name: Master Seat
rooms.description: Three sockets are cut into the master wheel: draw down the lake, seal off the emptied lower homes, or split the flow through the return. A locking dog will drop after one choice.

encounters.cue: Pin the relief drums open permanently. The homes will be dry and the ferry lake will empty.
encounters.result: The lake drains through the cliff spillway. The lower homes keep their hearths. Iven steps from his grounded ferry onto the white road that will replace his crossing. The shift bell rings once for a road.
encounters.hint: Hear Edda’s warning and call both crews at the pilot bell before pinning the wheel.

encounters.cue: Seal the evacuated homes and keep Iven’s lake at ferry height.
encounters.result: The lower doors close on empty rooms. Families move into the high galleries. Iven ferries the first load of salvaged doors across a lake that keeps its name. The shift bell rings twice for the lost homes.
encounters.hint: Edda needs everyone accounted for on the high landing before the lower doors close.

encounters.cue: Lock the calibrated return in parallel with the main seat. The two crews must tend it together.
encounters.result: The twin streams settle at ferry height. Homes and crossing survive, on one condition: both crews must tend the return each shift. Above and below answer the bell together.
encounters.hint: Consult Edda, call the crews, and calibrate the listening works return valve before sharing the flow.

changes.text: The locking dog has dropped into DRAW. The relief drums feed the cliff spillway over a new white lake road.
The locking dog has dropped into SEAL. The ferry can float above the lower homes now that their people are safe.
The locking dog holds the fork in balance. Two keepers sign each shift line, one from either bank.

rooms.name: Names Gallery
rooms.description: Roof braces cut from nursery doors still carry the names of their last small occupants.

rooms.name: Cupboard of Flares
rooms.description: Packing straw surrounds three cold flares. Their colours match the enamel on the master wheel.

rooms.name: Escape Sill
rooms.description: The sill is worn by hands climbing out. Someone on the safe side carved a fingerhold for the last person.

rooms.name: Dry Siren
rooms.description: The siren is turned by compressed air from the gate. Silence here used to mean that the gate was safe.

rooms.name: Pressure Beach
rooms.description: The smooth shoreline exists inside the dam wall. Fine white sand shifts a little farther with every stroke.

rooms.name: Watch Desk
rooms.description: A watch book stands open for the next keeper. The nib is capped to keep it from rusting before a name can be entered.

rooms.name: Daylight Crack
rooms.description: Natural light reaches a crack scarcely wider than a page. The sound of the lake comes and goes in it.

rooms.name: Last Lamp
rooms.description: The last oil lamp before the surface burns beside a blank brass plate for the names of those who answer the bell.
